🚨 Boletim de Cyber Segurança - Técnica
Visão geral:

Infraestrutura - Docker / ESX / Elastic / Grafana / Nginx / VMware / Zabbix

🚨 CVE-2026-107333 - Nginx
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Nginx
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.1
Resumo:
Malcolm's nginx based reverse proxy contains a URL path normalization inconsistency between its Lua based role-based access control (RBAC) authorization layer and nginx's own request routing logic. An authenticated user can craft a specially formatted request path to bypass role-based restrictions and reach administrative or role gated endpoints they should not have access to. This affects all restricted paths protec...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-107333
 
🚨 CVE-2026-107335 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.5
Resumo:
Malcolm's upload-processing pipeline (scripts/safe-extract.py) enforces entry-count, nesting-depth, and total-uncompressed-byte limits when extracting container archives (zip/tar/rar/7z via libarchive), but those limits are not applied when the uploaded file is a single-stream compressed format (.gz, .bz2, .xz, .lzma, .lz) that isn't a .tar.*-style archive. Any authenticated user permitted to upload PCAP/log files ca...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-107335
 
📢 CRITICAL ADVISORY: Pre-Upgrade Verification Required for vSphere Supervisor and VKS Environments Upgrading to vCenter 9.1.0 or 9.1.1
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: VMware
Fonte: https://blogs.vmware.com/feed
CVSS: 9.1
Resumo:
Overview and Call to Action While critical advisories are not typical blog topics, protecting customer environments and preventing unexpected data loss is our top priority. We are leveraging every communication channel available to ensure platform and infrastructure administrators are aware of a critical upgrade prerequisite. If you run vSphere Supervisor or VMware vSphere Kubernetes Service …
Link: https://blogs.vmware.com/cloud-foundation/2026/10/09/critical-advisory-pre-upgrade-verification-required-for-vsphere-supervisor-and-vks-environments-upgrading-to-vcenter-9-1-0-or-9-1-1/
 
📰 Creating a FinOps Dashboard in VMware Cloud Foundation
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: ESX
Fonte: https://blogs.vmware.com/feed
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
In Part 1 of this series, we established the backend FinOps architecture within VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF). By combining Custom Groups, custom metadata (Monthly_Budget), Chargeback metering metrics, and policy-scoped Super Metrics, we built an automated alert engine that fires warning notifications the moment a tenant organization breaches 80% of its monthly budget allocation.
Link: https://blogs.vmware.com/cloud-foundation/2026/10/09/creating-a-finops-dashboard-in-vmware-cloud-foundation/
 
📰 Beyond the Kubernetes complexity: Delivering an AI-Ready Platform Developers Love (Over Lunch)
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: ESX
Fonte: https://blogs.vmware.com/feed
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Developers want to push code and watch the platform take care of the rest—packaging images, configuring variables, and deploying to a secure, highly available environment.This is the core promise of delivering an opinionated Private cloud Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) with VMware Tanzu Platform on VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF).
Link: https://blogs.vmware.com/tanzu/beyond-the-kubernetes-complexity-delivering-an-ai-ready-platform-developers-love-over-lunch/

Segurança - Acronis / Axur / Check Point / Harmony SASE / Qualys / SentinelOne

🚨 CVE-2026-107729 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 5.5
Resumo:
SumatraPDF is a multi-format reader for Windows. In 3.7.0.22298, src/MobiDoc.cpp narrows the untrusted unsigned mobiHdr.hdrLen field to a signed integer for validation; values above INT_MAX become negative and bypass the upper-bound check. When the EXTH flag is set, the original unsigned value is reused as a pointer offset, causing DecodeExthHeader() to read beyond the record buffer. Opening a crafted MOBI file can r...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-107729
 
💣 Researchers Publish Working Exploit for Pre-Auth AnyDesk Linux Flaw That Gives Root Access
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 8.0
Resumo:
Security researchers have published a full working exploit for a pre-authentication remote code execution flaw in AnyDesk Linux that gives attackers root access before anyone approves the connection. AnyDesk patched the flaw in version 8.0.3 in June, but its changelog described the fix only as "fixed a bug that could lead to a crash," with no CVE assigned and no security
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/researchers-publish-working-exploit-for.html
 
💣 Unpatched AhsayCBS flaws exploited to deploy webshells, mine crypto
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Threat actors are exploiting one critical and one medium-severity vulnerability still unpatched in the AhsayCBS backup management platform to deploy webshells and cryptocurrency miners.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/unpatched-ahsaycbs-flaws-exploited-to-deploy-webshells-mine-crypto/
 
📰 Hackers abuse Google Ads, Bing redirects to push Claude ClickFix attacks
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Hackers are abusing legitimate Bing search-result redirects as click URLs in Google search ads to direct users to fake Claude installers that deliver ClickFix attacks.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hackers-abuse-google-ads-bing-redirects-to-push-claude-clickfix-attacks/

Sistemas / Cloud - 1Password / Azure / Office / Ubuntu / Windows Server / WordPress

🚨 USN-8910-1: libxml2 vulnerabilities
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/rss.xml
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Yirou Yang discovered that libxml2 incorrectly handled certain XML catalogs. If a user or automated system was tricked into processing a specially crafted XML catalog, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause libxml2 to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-76781) It was discovered that libxml2 incorrectly handled certain large qualified names, leading to a heap-based buffer overflow. An attack...
Link: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8910-1
 
🚨 USN-8911-1: Linux kernel (OEM) vulnerabilities
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/rss.xml
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Several security issues were discovered in the Linux kernel. An attacker could possibly use these to compromise the system. This update corrects flaws in the following subsystems: - Hardware crypto device drivers; - NVIDIA Tegra memory controller driver; - Network drivers; - USB core drivers; - GFS2 file system; - OCFS2 file system; - SMB network file system; - SoundWire (SDCA) ASoC drivers; - B.A.T.M.A.N. meshing pr...
Link: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8911-1
 
🚨 USN-8908-1: BlueZ vulnerabilities
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/rss.xml
CVSS: 0.0
Resumo:
Michael Bommarito discovered that BlueZ incorrectly handled codec capability storage in the A2DP profile. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a stack buffer overflow, resulting in a denial of service or arbitrary code execution. This issue only affected Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-19774) It was discovered that BlueZ incorrectly handled packet len...
Link: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8908-1
